page.overview:
Who is Boss Brolder?

Boss Brolder is a boss that appears in Super Mario 3D World and Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury. It serves as the primary boss of World 4, later on serves as one of the two first bosses of World Castle and is overall the fifth and later either the tenth or eleventh boss of the game.

As his name suggests, Boss Brolder resembles a regular Brolder but with some key differences. Boss Brolder's arm and body are constantly flowing with lava. His eyes now have a golden-orange glow and an angry scowl. Shards of rock and crystal now protrude from his body, and a large chunk of crystal is placed below Boss Brolder's eyes, making it look like a nose. Boss Brolder is the supposed leader of the Brolders.

He is fought at the end castle of World 4, at a blockade in World Bowser, and at the Boss Rush level in World Flower. Like most bosses in the game, Boss Brolder will explode after being defeated by the player.
